build_bucketing_bbox_coder: build a BucketingBBoxCoder instance with num_buckets and scale_factor for SABL boundary localization
encode_bboxes_to_buckets: encode source bboxes and ground truth bboxes into bucketing estimation and fine regression targets
decode_buckets_to_bboxes: decode bucketing predictions and offset predictions back to decoded bounding boxes
generate_buckets_from_proposals: generate left, right, top, and down buckets from proposals using num_buckets and scale_factor
apply_bucket2bbox_transformation: apply bucketing estimation and fine regression to generate detected bboxes with localization confidence
